entries.name: Locate
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A single isolated small fantasy game toolbar icon: a golden compass pointer arrow centered in a simple ivory compass ring, unmistakably MY CURRENT LOCATION / center map on player. WoW classic hand-painted map marker style, warm ivory, muted antique brass-gold, small cyan accent, dark brown outline. Bold chunky silhouette legible at 20 pixels. Minimal internal details, crisp edges, front view, centered fills 80 percent square. Genuine transparent background. No tile, no frame, no shadows behind, no lettering, no multiple icons. Production raster asset for Mapperly alongside painted hearthstone and mailbox icons.
